tldr: Anthropic's Claude is a loose grouping, not one developing story. On Sep 22-23 two reports said Chinese regulators opened a probe of DeepSeek and Moonshot AI over Anthropic's claims that they route requests to Claude.
whats_new: Anthropic published a first-party account of rebuilding its own inbound sales on Claude Managed Agents, where a buying agent now answers most inbound customers.
why_it_matters: The probe shows Claude API traffic now carries regulatory risk for Chinese labs, while Anthropic's sales post is a worked Managed Agents deployment pattern to compare against your own.

status.detail: Two China-probe reports and one unrelated Anthropic product post share only the Claude name.

beats.headline: China probes DeepSeek and Moonshot over alleged routing of requests to Claude
beats.summary: Two reports, Sep 22 and Sep 23, frame the probe around Anthropic's claims about data leaking to Claude.

beats.headline: Anthropic's sales team rebuilds inbound on Claude Managed Agents
beats.summary: Unrelated to the probe; a first-party deployment write-up.

open_questions: Do Chinese regulators publish findings or penalties from the DeepSeek and Moonshot probe?
Does Anthropic publish the evidence behind its routing claims?
take_for_builders: If you run Managed Agents, compare the sales post's buying-agent design against your own handoff and escalation rules; treat the probe as context only until findings are published.
